art_note: Standard e-commerce mockups with digital print overlays detract from the luxury brand positioning.
desc_en: Designed for fluid movement. These sneakers combine a contemporary silhouette with functional materials for daily wear. Crafted from mesh and PVC, they feature a seamless elastic upper that moves with your stride. The soft, breathable MD outsole ensures lightweight support. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Disenadas para el movimiento fluido. Estas zapatillas combinan una silueta contemporanea con materiales funcionales para el dia a dia. Confeccionadas con malla y PVC, incorporan una parte superior elastica sin costuras que acompanan el paso. La suela exterior de MD suave y transpirable asegura un soporte ligero. Cada par se confecciona bajo pedido con envios a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Mesh and PVC upper
· MD outsole
· Seamless elastic upper
· Laced closure
· Hand wash or gentle machine wash, naturally air dry
· Made to order with worldwide shipping
details_es:
